title: Data Set and Reference Models of EMPS
authors: Alexandre Janot | Maxime Gautier | Mathieu Brunot
evidence_or_scope: The variable list labels vir as force in N. Eq. 7 and later text identify the controller signal with ν/vir, scaled by 35.15 N/V for force. The simulation code declares a maximum voltage of 10. This documentary inconsistency and simulated limit preclude treating vir alone as an independently measured force or a saturation flag.
rights_and_data: Public report. Raw report and source dataset not reproduced in the literature table.

title: Coupled Electric Drives Data Set and Reference Models
authors: Torbjörn Wigren | Maarten Schoukens

rights_and_data: Public report. Raw report and source dataset not reproduced in the literature table.
